summary.name: iTranslate
summary.one_liner: iTranslate is a translation app for text, voice, camera images, web pages and messaging keyboards, covering over 100 languages.
keywords: read and write in other languages
use_cases: translating menus and signs with a phone camera
looking up word meanings and verb conjugations
summary.what_it_does: iTranslate translates typed text in more than 100 languages, with autocomplete and alternative translations. Its voice mode recognizes speech and translates it into a chosen language. The camera mode translates text in photos such as menus, cards and signs. A keyboard extension provides translations inside messaging apps. The page also describes offline translation in a few popular languages and says it can translate websites and look up word meanings and verb conjugations.
notable: Offline translation, currently in 4 languages according to the page
Camera translation for menus and signs
Keyboard extension for translating inside messaging apps
Privacy stated as a core value, with data kept under the user's control
caveats: Offline mode covers only a limited set of languages (4 per the page, 'many popular languages' elsewhere)
Page does not state pricing or whether features require payment
Platform list is vague: page says 'a large variety of platforms and devices' without naming them
